headline: Anthropic raises $81.3 billion in record $1.5 trillion public debut
summary: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, above its marketed range of $70 to $78, raising $81.3 billion. The Claude maker became the first pure-play AI company to list publicly.
why: Anthropic is a major artificial intelligence research and safety company and developer of the Claude large language model family, making its initial public offering a benchmark for artificial intelligence valuations.
